findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Illustrative specification" above "Containerized Application"; "Sub-second heartbeat verification" above "Uptime Monitoring"; "visualization" above "The Living System"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "Fig. 01 - Architecture of curi", "001", "002", "003", "004", "01"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 29 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Fig. 01 - Architecture of curiosity", "- Principles of digital curation", "Illustrative specification", "architecture").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 29 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.station-header 1440px | section#personal-space.chapter 1440px | section#exhibits.chapter 1440px | ol.departures 1144px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Fig. 01 - Architecture of curiosity" 3.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "Traffic Distribution" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Caching Layer" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Deployment Scaffold" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 883px of the width empty: "The Living System".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 40% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×360px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 2 of 6 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 1, 4.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#personal-space.chapter at 1025px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.
